    The types E: traces and the brick hypothesis #

    Appendix A: the possible correction classes of E₆, E₇, E₈ live in path degrees six, ten and eighteen; their periods are excluded by deletion to D₄ (Lemma A.5) or to E₇ (Lemma A.7) and the brick hypothesis.

    First the exclusion on a periodic star model: if the deck generator g fixes the retained vertices after n steps and n c₀ = d, closed paths of degree d of Π of the retained part lift to closed paths of Q, and the brick hypothesis fails (not_brick_star).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    ¬ScalarMeshCategory.BrickHypothesis c

    Exclusion of a period by deletion. Let Del be a ρ-stable set of vertices of the star not containing the centre, let n c₀ = d > 0, and let ρ^n fix every retained vertex. If each retained vertex carries a closed path of degree d that is nonzero in Π modulo Del, the brick hypothesis fails.
